market_cap_context.note: Financial-statement amounts were disclosed in HK$'000 and converted to CNY absolute yuan using the input HKD/CNY rate 0.909188985824585 to match the market-cap currency.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Cash is mostly USD/RMB/HKD and ordinary bank cash, but the annual report does not split parent/subsidiary ownership. The group has PRC, Cambodia, Vietnam and Honduras operations and RMB/VND convertibility frictions, so a group-cash discount is required.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash can partly be used for dividends, debt service or other owner actions, but not all cash can be removed without affecting operations.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Listed bonds are marketable but have issuer credit, interest-rate and mark-to-market risk; maturities extend to August 2026.
cash_breakdown.reason: Non-operating treasury investment disclosed separately from operating receivables.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Bond funds are redeemable financial assets but not cash; product liquidity and underlying credit/duration risk are not fully disclosed.
cash_breakdown.reason: Non-operating treasury investment, but less certain than direct cash.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Investment funds are non-cash FVTPL products with insufficient disclosure of redemption terms and holdings; default discount is low.
cash_breakdown.reason: Could be sold or redeemed, but uncertain liquidity and valuation warrant a large haircut.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Although classified as a financial asset, note 20 identifies the item as trade receivables at FVTOCI, so it is operating working capital rather than detachable funds.
cash_breakdown.reason: Not included in detachable cash assets.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Reserve based on roughly 1.5-2 months of manufacturing operating cash cost, considering 0-120 day customer credit periods, inventory needs and multi-country operations.
cash_breakdown.reason: Deducted from discounted detachable cash assets because removing it would impair continuing operations.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Reserve for multi-currency cash extraction, RMB/VND convertibility constraints, dividend flow and transaction friction.
cash_breakdown.reason: Deducted from discounted detachable cash assets.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Management discussion states there were no outstanding bank loans at 31 December 2023.
These are ordinary operating lease liabilities needed for continuing factories/offices and are reflected in profit/cash-flow quality rather than treated as a separate detachable-cash debt deduction.
cash_breakdown.reason: Tracked as financing-like liability, but not deducted from detachable net cash under continuing-operation owner-earnback view.

profit_quality.assessment: Cash conversion is good on a three-year view after the weak 2021 working-capital year: 2021-2023 parent net profit was HK$158.316m, HK$172.553m and HK$175.420m, while operating cash flow was HK$83.945m, HK$237.528m and HK$273.238m. The main denominator uses the three-year median parent net profit of HK$172.553m less median capex of HK$8.028m, then applies a 0.75 haircut.
adjustments: Excluded operating receivables at FVTOCI from detachable funds.
Used zero normalized working-capital release despite 2022-2023 positive working-capital movement, because 2021 absorbed substantial working capital and the business has 0-120 day customer credit.
Applied a 0.75 profit haircut for customer concentration, expansion cash needs and recurring exposure to FX/trade-finance costs.
Did not add back FVTPL losses to the denominator as sustainable operating cash profit; the core business already produced sufficient reported profit and cash flow without relying on investment gains.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2021-2023 operating free cash flow was approximately HK$75.917m, HK$228.495m and HK$265.361m; median operating FCF exceeded median reported parent net profit, but the first year shows material working-capital sensitivity.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Stable reported profits and strong 2022-2023 cash flow support a positive denominator, but not a near-1.0 haircut because Customer A represented more than 80% of revenue, 2021 cash conversion was weak due to working capital, and Vietnam/Honduras expansion requires operating resources.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Three-year operating cash flow / parent net profit median ratio is about 1.56x; conservative calculation avoids crediting temporary working-capital release.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed; median 2021-2023 purchase of property, plant and equipment, HK$8.028m, is used as proxy.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2023 and 2022 working capital released cash, while 2021 absorbed cash; main denominator does not include positive working-capital release.

limitations: Market cap is from rough-screen historical input, not a freshly verified current market cap.
Cash is not split by legal entity, parent/subsidiary or unrestricted/restricted status, so the cash haircut is conservative.
The annual report discloses pledged assets with net book value HK$121.5m for unutilised banking facilities but does not fully identify whether any cash is pledged.
Customer concentration is material: Customer A contributed HK$922.276m of HK$1,114.213m revenue.
Maintenance capex is estimated from total PPE purchases because the annual report does not split maintenance and growth capex.
